emails.subject: Following up on the project
emails.body: Hi, just wanted to follow up on the website project we discussed last week. Have you had a chance to review the proposal I sent over? Let me know if you have any questions.

emails.subject: Re: Following up on the project
emails.body: Hey, yes I did look it over. Looks good overall. I had a couple of questions about the timeline and the animation scope. Can we jump on a quick call this week to go over the details?

emails.subject: Re: Following up on the project
emails.body: Absolutely, Thursday works great for me. How does 2pm sound? I will send over a calendar invite once you confirm.
